title: BYD shares slide as fierce China competition dents first-half earnings
summary: Chinese automaker BYD's stock declined following earnings release despite higher second-quarter profits and international growth, signaling competitive pressures in China's domestic automotive market. The market reaction reflects investor concerns about margin pressure from intense competition offsetting international expansion gains.
content: BYD shares slid after the automaker released its latest results on Friday, despite higher second-quarter profit and overseas growth.

zh.title: BYD股价下滑，中国竞争激烈打击上半年收益
zh.summary: 中国汽车制造商BYD发布财报后股价下跌，尽管第二季度利润更高且国际增长强劲，但反映出中国国内汽车市场的竞争压力。市场反应反映了投资者担忧来自激烈竞争的利润压力会抵消国际扩张的收益。

title: Jackson Hole analyst roundup: Warsh's speech sends hike chances higher, may put Fed `at odds' with Treasury
summary: Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh's hawkish Jackson Hole speech has increased market expectations of a potential rate hike at September's FOMC meeting, potentially creating tension with Treasury priorities. The comments signal the Fed may maintain its tighter monetary policy stance.
content: Fed Chair Kevin Warsh's hawkish stance reinforced expectations of a relatively tighter stance at the Federal Open Market Committee meeting in September.

zh.title: 杰克逊霍尔分析师综述：沃什演讲提高加息预期，可能使美联储与财政部产生分歧
zh.summary: 美联储主席凯文·沃什在杰克逊霍尔的鹰派演讲提高了市场对9月FOMC会议可能加息的预期，可能引发与财政部优先事项的紧张关系。这些评论表明美联储可能维持更紧的货币政策立场。

title: Stock futures fall after U.S. strikes Iran; Wall Street heads for winning month: Live updates
summary: U.S. military strikes on Iran triggered stock futures declines despite the Dow being on pace for its fifth consecutive monthly gain in August, illustrating how geopolitical tensions create volatility against broader positive market trends. August is shaping up as a winning month for Wall Street despite recent headwinds.
content: The Dow is up 2.1% in August, on pace for its fifth consecutive monthly advance.

zh.title: 美国打击伊朗后股指期货下跌；华尔街走向赢利月份：实时更新
zh.summary: 美国对伊朗的军事打击引发股指期货下跌，尽管道指有望实现8月份连续第五个月上涨，这说明地缘政治紧张局势如何在更广泛的积极市场趋势中造成波动。8月份尽管面临最近的逆风，但正成为华尔街的赢利月份。

title: China's factory activity shrinks for second straight month, contracting less than expected
summary: China's manufacturing activity contracted for a second straight month but less severely than anticipated, keeping pressure on Beijing to implement additional economic stimulus. The data signals slowing momentum in the world's second-largest economy despite policy support efforts.
content: China's manufacturing activity shrank for a second straight month, keeping pressure on Beijing to support the economy as growth loses momentum.

zh.title: 中国工厂活动连续第二个月萎缩，收缩幅度小于预期
zh.summary: 中国制造业活动连续第二个月收缩，但幅度小于预期，这给北京实施额外经济刺激措施带来了压力。这些数据表明，尽管有政策支持，全球第二大经济体的势头在放缓。

title: U.S. stock futures slip as chances of rate hike rise after Warsh’s Jackson Hole comments
summary: U.S. stock index futures declined as Fed Chair Warsh's Jackson Hole remarks increased expectations for a September rate hike, while renewed U.S.-Iran military tensions add to market uncertainty. Investors face dual headwinds from potential monetary tightening and geopolitical escalation.
content: U.S. stock-index futures declined on Sunday, as investors ponder the likelihood of a fresh interest-rate hike and as new fighting between the U.S. and Iran threatens to reignite the conflict.

zh.title: 沃什联储主席杰克逊霍尔讲话后加息可能性上升，美国股指期货下跌
zh.summary: 美国股指期货下跌，因为联储主席沃什在杰克逊霍尔讲话增加了9月加息的预期，而美伊军事紧张局势升级加剧了市场不确定性。投资者面临潜在货币紧缩和地缘政治升级的双重压力。

title: Trump threatens to blow up Iran's Kharg Island oil hub as hostilities escalate once again
summary: Former President Trump threatened strikes on Iran's Kharg Island oil facility as U.S.-Iran hostilities escalate following major military operations in late July. The rhetoric increases risks of further conflict and potential disruption to global energy supplies.
content: The last major U.S. strikes on Iran were carried out in late July.

zh.title: 随着敌对行动再次升级，特朗普威胁摧毁伊朗霍格岛油气枢纽
zh.summary: 前总统特朗普威胁对伊朗霍格岛石油设施进行打击，因为美伊敌对行动在7月下旬重大军事行动后升级。这些言辞增加了进一步冲突和全球能源供应中断的风险。

title: Meta- and Google-backed Indian telecom operator Jio Platforms gets regulatory nod for IPO
summary: Jio Platforms, India's largest digital and telecom operator backed by Meta and Google, received regulatory approval for its initial public offering. The clearance advances a major capital market debut in India's technology sector, though the National Stock Exchange's own IPO still awaits approval.
content: India's largest digital and telecom operator, Jio Platforms, got a regulatory nod for an IPO, but the National Stock Exchange, another mega issue, is still awaiting regulatory clearance.

zh.title: Meta和Google支持的印度电信运营商Jio Platforms获得IPO监管批准
zh.summary: 由Meta和Google支持的印度最大数字电信运营商Jio Platforms获得了首次公开募股的监管批准。这一批准推进了印度科技部门的重大资本市场首秀，尽管印度国家证券交易所自身的IPO仍在等待批准。

title: Oil rises over 1% after U.S. forces strike two Iranian rocket launchers on Larak Island
summary: Oil prices rose more than 1% following U.S. military strikes on Iranian rocket launchers, driven by investor concerns over potential Middle Eastern supply disruptions. Geopolitical risk premiums are intensifying crude market volatility amid escalating U.S.-Iran tensions.
content: Oil rises Monday, amid heightened concerns over supply disruptions after U.S. forces struck two Iranian rocket launchers on Larak Island on Sunday.

zh.title: 美国军队打击拉拉克岛伊朗火箭发射器后油价上涨超过1%
zh.summary: 美国军事打击伊朗火箭发射器后，油价上涨超过1%，投资者担心中东供应可能中断。在美伊关系升级的背景下，地缘政治风险溢价加剧了原油市场的波动。

title: How the US-Canada trade war is being felt on both sides of the border
summary: The U.S.-Canada trade conflict is creating measurable economic effects across communities and businesses on both sides of the border. The trade tensions are generating real-world impacts for North American commerce and consumers.
content: The US-Canada trade war is being felt on both sides of the border.

zh.title: 美加贸易战如何在边境两侧产生影响
zh.summary: 美加贸易冲突在边境两侧的社区和企业中产生了可衡量的经济影响。贸易紧张局势对北美商业和消费者产生了现实影响。
